events.title: Tankers near Oman come under fire as Iran threatens to choke off shipping routes
events.description: Tankers near Oman were attacked as Iran threatened to disrupt shipping routes.

events.title: UEFA Welcomes FIFA's Decision to Scrap Stake Sale
events.description: UEFA has welcomed FIFA's decision to scrap its plans to sell a stake in the World Cup, a proposal that had been met with widespread opposition from European football's governing body.

events.title: Egypt Wins Chairmanship of AI Governance and Quantum Computing Working Groups
events.description: Egypt has won the presidency of the AI Governance Working Group and the Quantum Computing Working Group under the Arab Permanent Committee for AI and Emerging Technologies.

events.title: Spain Installs Floating Barrier in Ceuta After Influx of Migrants
events.description: Spain installed a floating barrier in Ceuta after an influx of migrants from Morocco, with at least 67 people dying in the attempt to cross the border.

events.title: Iran Accuses U.S. of Escalating Tensions as Washington Plans More Strikes
events.description: Iran accused the U.S. of escalating tensions in the region and said it's preparing its own response if Washington goes ahead with new strikes.

events.title: Kuwait Intercepts Iranian Drones as US Weighs Fresh Strikes
events.description: Kuwait's air defenses have intercepted and destroyed Iranian drones, as the US weighs fresh strikes against Iran.

events.title: US Makes Visa Bond Program Permanent For 50 Countries
events.description: The US State Department has made its visa bond program permanent, allowing consular officers to require certain B1/B2 visa applicants from 50 countries to post bonds of up to $20,000.

events.title: Argentina and South Korea Announce Critical Minerals Partnership
events.description: Argentina and South Korea have announced a partnership to deepen cooperation in critical minerals, energy, and trade.

events.title: Spain-Morocco border crisis
events.description: Spain has stopped migrant crossings into its North African territory of Ceuta, with police installing a 500-meter floating barrier off its border with Morocco.

events.title: Russia hits Ukrainian capital
events.description: Russia launched a barrage of ballistic missiles and drones into Kyiv, killing at least nine people and injuring 22.

events.title: Humanitarian aid delivered to Venezuela
events.description: A Russian company has delivered humanitarian aid to Venezuela's La Guaira state.

events.title: Russian strikes on Kyiv
events.description: Russian strikes on Ukraine's capital killed at least nine people and wounded more than two dozen others.

events.title: US Drops Charges Against Olympian
events.description: The US Department of Justice dropped its case against Olympian David Hearn, who was accused of damaging the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.

events.title: Peru's Ex-President Released
events.description: Peru's ex-president Ollanta Humala was released after his conviction was overturned.

events.title: FIFA Scraps Private Investment Plan
events.description: FIFA has dropped its plan to sell a stake in the World Cup to private investors after opposition from football officials.

events.title: Trump doubles down on Iran threat
events.description: US President Donald Trump has reiterated his threat to hit Iran 'very hard', raising the possibility of new strikes.

events.title: FIFA scraps World Cup sell-off plan
events.description: FIFA President Gianni Infantino announced that the organization is scrapping plans to sell shares in the World Cup to private investors.

events.title: Russian forces hit Ukrainian cargo vessels
events.description: Russian forces have hit over 80 vessels involved in cargo deliveries for the Ukrainian army in July.

events.title: China and US agree on soybean trade
events.description: Chinese government buyers have bought at least eight cargoes of US soybeans for shipment from US Gulf Coast terminals.

events.title: Iran warns of retaliation against US
events.description: Iran has warned that the global economy will pay the price if the US attacks again.

events.title: US and Israel plan strikes on Iran
events.description: The US and Israel are planning a potential bombing campaign targeting Iran's energy infrastructure.

events.title: Naples earthquake
events.description: A 4.7 magnitude earthquake struck Naples, causing damage and panic.

events.title: Spain migrant crisis
events.description: Tens of thousands of migrants crossed into Spain's North African territory, with dozens killed and many returned to Morocco.

events.title: Morocco's King Mohammed VI marks 27th anniversary
events.description: Morocco's King Mohammed VI has marked the 27th anniversary of his accession to the throne, receiving congratulatory messages from world leaders.

events.title: South Korea and Argentina Agree to Enhance Cooperation on Critical Minerals
events.description: South Korea and Argentina have agreed to enhance cooperation on critical minerals, in a bid to strengthen their economic ties.

events.title: US and Iran Conflict Escalates, With No End in Sight
events.description: The conflict between the US and Iran continues to escalate, with both sides exchanging blows and no end to the violence in sight.

events.title: India-Bangladesh-US diplomatic meeting
events.description: India's High Commissioner to Bangladesh met with the US Ambassador to India in Dhaka, marking a first for such a meeting in a foreign location.

events.title: Two-Week Ceasefire Intended to Allow Hamas Disarmament, Launch Peace Deal
events.description: There is currently a two-week ceasefire to finalize the details of the process. However, if Hamas does not begin the process, this will be considered a violation of and an end to the ceasefire.

events.title: Two-Week Ceasefire in Gaza
events.description: A two-week ceasefire is in place to allow Hamas to disarm and launch a peace deal.

events.title: Migrant Crisis in Ceuta
events.description: Around 60,000 migrants crossed into the Spanish territory of Ceuta from Morocco, sparking a crisis in Europe.

events.title: At least 57 people die as tens of thousands cross to Spanish enclave of Ceuta from Morocco
events.description: At least 57 people have died trying to reach the Spanish enclave of Ceuta after as many as 60,000 migrants surged into the territory from Morocco.
